title: fieldshift · campo
description: Lo que miden las balizas de cada finca (buckets <cliente>_campo). c001 son las ESP32 reales (histórico anterior sintético); c002-c004, fincas simuladas.

list.name: finca
list.label: Finca
list.query: Demo (ESP32 reales) : c001,Bajo Cinca : c002,Slaney : c003,Romerike : c004

list.name: por
list.label: Ver por
list.query: zona : zona,baliza : baliza,toda la finca : finca

list.name: baliza
list.label: Balizas
list.query: SELECT coalesce(label, id) AS __text, id AS __value FROM balizas WHERE cliente_id = '${finca}' ORDER BY coalesce(label, id)

list.name: meta
list.query: SELECT string_agg(id || '=' || coalesce(label, id) || '=' || coalesce(zona, '-'), ';' ORDER BY id) FROM balizas WHERE cliente_id = '${finca}'

panels.title: Ahora (media de las balizas elegidas, última lectura de cada una)

targets.query:
import "strings"
import "dict"
import "array"
filas = array.map(arr: strings.split(v: "${meta:raw}", t: ";"), fn: (x) => strings.split(v: x, t: "="))
nombre = dict.fromList(pairs: array.map(arr: filas, fn: (x) => ({key: x[0], value: x[1]})))
zona = dict.fromList(pairs: array.map(arr: filas, fn: (x) => ({key: x[0], value: x[2]})))
from(bucket: "${finca}_campo") |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "atmosfera" and r._field == "temp_aire")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dispositivo, set: ${baliza:json}) and dict.get(dict: nombre, key: r.dispositivo, default: "") != "")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= -40.0 and r._value <= 60.0)
  |> group(columns: ["dispositivo"]) |> last()
  |> group() |> mean()

import "strings"
import "dict"
import "array"
filas = array.map(arr: strings.split(v: "${meta:raw}", t: ";"), fn: (x) => strings.split(v: x, t: "="))
nombre = dict.fromList(pairs: array.map(arr: filas, fn: (x) => ({key: x[0], value: x[1]})))
zona = dict.fromList(pairs: array.map(arr: filas, fn: (x) => ({key: x[0], value: x[2]})))
from(bucket: "${finca}_campo") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "atmosfera" and r._field == "temp_aire")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dispositivo, set: ${baliza:json}) and dict.get(dict: nombre, key: r.dispositivo, default: "") != "")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= -40.0 and r._value <= 60.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with serie:
      if "${por}" == "zona" then (if dict.get(dict: zona, key: r.dispositivo, default: "-") == "-" then "sin zona"
                                   else dict.get(dict: zona, key: r.dispositivo, default: "-"))
      else if "${por}" == "baliza" then dict.get(dict: nombre, key: r.dispositivo, default: r.dispositivo)
      else "media de la finca"}))
  |> group(columns: ["serie"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "serie"])
